title: Recover path registration after checkout creation
when: Physical checkout creation succeeded but recording its path refused.
need: Keep the checkout and its contents. With the item work claim, read the active lane id and branch, verify the physical branch, then record the fully qualified client path. POSIX, Windows drive-rooted and complete backslash UNC spellings are metadata; the server does not inspect client files. Stale lanes, wrong branches, inactive items and duplicate active paths refuse.
surface: Worktrees function catalog and path-record refusal
review: Candidate registered-handler round trips and CLI-to-handler recovery use isolated database and physical Git fixtures on POSIX. Deployed-server and real Windows execution are not established by these checks.
